goal.request: Use five independent agents, five random complex luxury concepts, the supplied portrait reference, audited prompts, and actual image generation to test whether the researched keywords survive into pixels.

evidence.claim: Five immutable v6 candidate packs expose the intended hard profile and five render gates each.
All five composed prompts and exact native render requests passed their blocking audits.
evidence.artifact: arm-*/composed_audit.txt and arm-*/render_audit.txt; coordinator reran both auditors

evidence.claim: Five built-in imagegen calls produced five saved PNG files, one call per independent arm and no retries.
The conspicuous original-code image passes all five native and thumbnail gates.
The bespoke image passes four gates but does not visibly expose canvas or an unmistakable internal pad-stitch field.
The service image passes four gates but its blank notebook is not visibly identifiable as aftercare continuation.
The high-jewelry image passes all five gates, including setting contact and supporting gallery at native scale.
The couture image passes all five gates, including exposed internal support and live hand finishing.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: Every selected luxury profile must retain all five required visual gates in the same saved image at its declared scale.

invariants.statement: Each arm keeps frozen request, core, intent, pack, and reference bytes and receives no other arm output.
A partial or metadata-only component cannot pass a pixel gate.

mismatches.source_state: The prompt explicitly requests a turned-back lapel exposing hand canvas and pad stitching.
mismatches.render_state: The jacket exterior and normal lapel facing are visible, but the internal canvas and pad-stitch field are not legible.

mismatches.source_state: The prompt requests a blank repair, restoration, or aftercare record linked to the same case.
mismatches.render_state: A blank notebook appears, but no visible diagram, maintenance step, linked material, or advisor action establishes its function.

hypotheses.statement: In a dense medium-wide multi-object scene, a locally small internal construction layer can disappear even when the evidence phrase is explicit.
hypotheses.falsifier: An unrelated held-out medium-wide bespoke scene repeatedly exposes canvas and pad stitching without a dedicated focal region or close view.

hypotheses.statement: A blank privacy-safe folder or notebook is not by itself a visually self-identifying aftercare record.
hypotheses.falsifier: Independent viewers consistently identify an unlabeled blank notebook as aftercare without relying on the prompt.

intervention.general_rule: Give small internal craft mechanisms a dedicated visible focal region, and represent privacy-safe service continuity with a non-personal functional diagram, checklist, matched sample, or active recording gesture instead of blank paper alone.
intervention.generalization_basis: The two failures occur in unrelated scenes and concern the same transferable boundary: semantic labels and prompt presence do not make a small or functionally ambiguous object readable in pixels.

decision.rationale: All package and prompt checks pass, but two of five independent renders lose one required local mechanism each. The candidate-pack family is promising at 23 of 25 gates, but the five-arm suite is not promotable as render-faithful until those failure modes are addressed and requalified.
